VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CULTIVATE.title: Cultivate
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CULTIVATE.description: Put a card from your hand into your Cultivate Pile. After X of your turns, harvest a card one rarity higher. X is the card's original cost (1-3). Ancient cards instead yield two copies of the same card.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_PERMANENT_CULTIVATE.desc: Put a card from your hand into your Cultivate Pile. It stays there permanently and never yields a card. Other effects can still remove it.
